concerns.text: FR-004 requires comparing 'the generated execution plan' (the SUT/router's plan) against the ground-truth plan. No task implements the SUT plan generator — T024 only says 'Binary translation-error comparison (FR-004) ... against T007 ground truth', and T007 IS the ground-truth engine. One side of the FR-004 comparison has no producing task; add a task implementing the simulated router/SUT plan generation (spec Assumption: 'unified router logic is simulated using a lightweight Python script').

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 vs data-model.md:File Formats and plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: data-model.md states generation_log.json is 'Validated by contracts/generation_log.schema.yaml' and plan.md lists both generation_log.schema.yaml and anova_results.schema.yaml under contracts/, but T004 creates neither schema, and no task writes data/processed/generation_log.json (the intermediate SSoT per data-model.md Data Flow steps 1–2). Add tasks (or extend T004/T006/T007) to produce the generation log and its schema, and the anova_results schema or remove it from the plan.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T021/T037 vs spec.md:US-1 scenario 1 and US-2 scenario 2
concerns.text: No task pins the query-set composition: US-1 requires 500 queries partitioned by exact depth (1,2,3,4+) and US-2 scenario 2 requires a set of 100 high-complexity graph queries. T021 only demands '≥ 30 queries' for the smoke run and T037 says '500-query set' without defining per-depth/per-source-type counts or the 100-query high-complexity graph subset. Amend T006/T021/T037 to specify these counts so the acceptance scenarios are satisfiable.

T013 contract-tests the ExecutionMetric schema, but that schema requires mismatch_flag, delta_latency, engine_version, and throttle_config — fields no task produces and absent from execution_logs.csv (T021's column list). Either add a task producing those fields, or point T013 at execution_log.schema.yaml / execution_metrics.schema.yaml so the contract test validates an artifact the pipeline actually emits.

analysis_result.schema.yaml requires mean_delta_latency, std_delta_latency, segmented_regression_knee_point and per-source/complexity grouping that no task outputs (T018 writes the different anova_results.json structure from data-model.md), and gam_results.schema.yaml (LMM, Jonckheere-Terpstra) has no implementing task. These are orphaned contracts with no covering task; reconcile T004/T018/T020 with them or drop them.
